title: Russia says no plague found in contacts of Siberian lab worker who died - NBC News
description: Plague had not been detected among close contacts of a worker in an anti-plague laboratory in Siberia who died last week, with 60% of the identified group tested so far, officials in Russia said Tuesday.

title: CNN now has a new owner. What will the future of the network be under Skydance? - AP News
description: CNN has a new owner: Skydance. After a tumultuous, roughly yearlong process, Skydance-owned Paramount closed its $81 billion buyout of Warner Bros. Discovery on Tuesday. And beyond Hollywood, the mega merger brings two titans of the American TV news landscape…

title: David Ellison Rallies the Troops at Warner Bros.’ Lot - The Hollywood Reporter
description: "It wasn’t easy to get here," the Skydance CEO said to the Burbank crowd. "At times it was downright ugly. And at nearly every turn, someone told us it couldn’t be done. And here we are."

title: Flu season could kick off ‘incredibly’ early — what scientists are watching - Nature
description: Cases in the Northern Hemisphere are cropping up weeks early, and they are dominated by a virus with a concerning mutation.

title: Cornell brings in ex-Justice official Sally Yates to review school’s handling of sex assault claims - AP News
description: Cornell University trustees have announced that former Deputy Attorney General Sally Yates will review how the university handles sexual misconduct complaints. Tuesday's announcement comes after days of outrage over allegations of a 2024 gang rape at a frater…
